immediate_management_additions: URGENT ACTION REQUIRED: Phytophthora infestans (Late Blight) spreads rapidly in cool, humid conditions. Isolate and bag severely infected plant tissue immediately.
Inspect all neighboring plants within a 5-meter radius.
Contact your Sub-County Agricultural Extension Officer immediately for registered fungicide options.
actions.escalation_note: Risk of complete field loss if unaddressed within 48 to 72 hours.

immediate_management_additions: Remove isolated infected lower leaves immediately and dispose away from the plot.
Cease any overhead irrigation; switch strictly to root-level watering.
Schedule a follow-up inspection in 2-3 days.
actions.escalation_note: Monitor daily for white downy sporulation on leaf undersides.

immediate_management_additions: Do NOT enter or prune plants while foliage is wet from rain or dew.
Disinfect pruning shears between each plant with 70% surgical spirit or 10% household bleach.
Copper sprays should only be used under local agricultural extension guidance as copper-resistant strains exist in Kenya.
actions.escalation_note: If spotting spreads to fruits with scab-like blisters, harvest green fruit may be unsellable.

immediate_management_additions: Leaf appears healthy. Continue standard integrated pest and crop management practices.
actions.escalation_note: No escalation required. Maintain record in farm history.

monitoring_additions: Current environmental humidity (>80%) significantly accelerates fungal sporulation. Inspect canopy daily in morning hours.

disclaimer: AI diagnosis provides decision support based on leaf computer vision. It is not an agronomic laboratory assay. For commercial treatment choices, consult a registered agricultural extension officer or agrochemical professional adhering to Kenya Pest Control Products Board (PCPB) guidelines.
